# Sourced by start.sh before Jellyfin opens its configuration. Same package UID.
hwa_device() {
    case "$1" in /dev/dri/renderD[0-9][0-9][0-9]) ;; *) return 1;; esac
    minor=${1#/dev/dri/renderD}
    [ "$minor" -ge 128 ] && [ "$minor" -le 191 ]
}

hwa_write() {
    hwa_state=$1; hwa_backend=$2; hwa_path=$3
    case "$hwa_backend" in vaapi) hwa_device "$hwa_path" || return 1;; none) ;; *) return 1;; esac
    hwa_config="$hwa_state/config/config/encoding.xml"
    mkdir -p "$hwa_state/config/config"
    if [ -L "$hwa_config" ]; then return 1; fi
    if [ -f "$hwa_config" ]; then
        # Change native serialized fields only; retain all unrelated user settings.
        # If a future upstream format differs, leave it untouched and fail safely.
        grep -q '</EncodingOptions>' "$hwa_config" || return 1
        sed "s|<HardwareAccelerationType>[^<]*</HardwareAccelerationType>|<HardwareAccelerationType>$hwa_backend</HardwareAccelerationType>|g" "$hwa_config" > "$hwa_config.pending"
        if ! grep -q '<HardwareAccelerationType>' "$hwa_config.pending"; then
            sed "s|</EncodingOptions>|<HardwareAccelerationType>$hwa_backend</HardwareAccelerationType></EncodingOptions>|" "$hwa_config.pending" > "$hwa_config.pending2"
            mv "$hwa_config.pending2" "$hwa_config.pending"
        fi
        if [ "$hwa_backend" = vaapi ]; then
            sed "s|<VaapiDevice>[^<]*</VaapiDevice>|<VaapiDevice>$hwa_path</VaapiDevice>|g; s|<EnableHardwareEncoding>[^<]*</EnableHardwareEncoding>|<EnableHardwareEncoding>true</EnableHardwareEncoding>|g" "$hwa_config.pending" > "$hwa_config.pending2"
            mv "$hwa_config.pending2" "$hwa_config.pending"
            if ! grep -q '<VaapiDevice>' "$hwa_config.pending"; then
                sed "s|</EncodingOptions>|<VaapiDevice>$hwa_path</VaapiDevice></EncodingOptions>|" "$hwa_config.pending" > "$hwa_config.pending2"
                mv "$hwa_config.pending2" "$hwa_config.pending"
            fi
        fi
    elif [ "$hwa_backend" = vaapi ]; then
        printf '<?xml version="1.0"?><EncodingOptions><HardwareAccelerationType>vaapi</HardwareAccelerationType><VaapiDevice>%s</VaapiDevice><EnableHardwareEncoding>true</EnableHardwareEncoding><HardwareDecodingCodecs><string>h264</string></HardwareDecodingCodecs></EncodingOptions>\n' "$hwa_path" > "$hwa_config.pending"
    else
        return 0
    fi
    chmod 600 "$hwa_config.pending"
    mv "$hwa_config.pending" "$hwa_config"
}

hwa_probe() {
    # Cold shared-library/driver loads can exceed 15s on disk-backed devices.
    if timeout -k 5 60 /usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -init_hw_device "vaapi=va:$1" -filter_hw_device va -f lavfi -i color=s=64x64:r=1 -vf format=nv12,hwupload -frames:v 1 -c:v h264_vaapi -f null - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        return 0
    else
        hwa_probe_status=$?
        printf 'VAAPI probe failed (exit %s).\n' "$hwa_probe_status" >&2
        return "$hwa_probe_status"
    fi
}

hwa_setup() {
    hwa_state=$1
    hwa_path=${SYNOPKGLAND_GPU_DEVICE:-}
    if [ "${SYNOPKGLAND_GPU_STATUS:-software}" = available ] && hwa_device "$hwa_path" && [ -c "$hwa_path" ] && [ -r "$hwa_path" ] && [ -w "$hwa_path" ] &&
        hwa_probe "$hwa_path"; then
        if [ ! -f "$hwa_state/hwa.initialized" ]; then
            hwa_write "$hwa_state" vaapi "$hwa_path" || return 1
            : > "$hwa_state/hwa.initialized"
        fi
        printf '%s\n' 'GPU render device ready; native encoding settings retained.'
    else
        hwa_write "$hwa_state" none '' || return 1
        rm -f "$hwa_state/hwa.initialized"
        printf '%s\n' 'Hardware acceleration unavailable; using software transcoding.'
    fi
}

#!/bin/sh
# Runtime runs only as the package UID. No upstream source or image is changed.
set -eu
umask 077
state=/var/tmp/jellyfin
plugin="$state/config/plugins/SSO Authentication_4.0.0.4"
mkdir -p "$plugin" "$state/config/config" "$state/cache"
. "$state/hwa.sh"
hwa_setup "$state"
# Build-verified release files arrive in bounded base64 argv chunks, never downloaded at startup.
while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
    file=$1; hash=$2; count=${3#chunks:}; shift 3
    case "$file" in SSO-Auth.dll|Duende.IdentityModel.dll|Duende.IdentityModel.OidcClient.dll|meta.json) ;; *) exit 1;; esac
    : > "$plugin/$file.pending"
    while [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; do
        printf '%s' "$1" | base64 -d >> "$plugin/$file.pending"
        shift; count=$((count-1))
    done
    printf '%s  %s\n' "$hash" "$plugin/$file.pending" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
    mv "$plugin/$file.pending" "$plugin/$file"
done
[ "${JELLYFIN_BIND:?}" = 127.0.0.1 ] || exit 1
case "${OIDC_SECRET:?}${BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD:?}" in *[!0-9a-f]*) exit 1;; esac
[ "${#OIDC_SECRET}" -eq 64 ] && [ "${#BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD}" -eq 64 ] || exit 1
# The SDK may regenerate secrets after delete-data while named volumes remain.
# Retain only the native bootstrap credential in the same private App volume.
if [ ! -f "$state/bootstrap.secret" ]; then
    printf '%s' "$BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD" > "$state/bootstrap.secret"
fi
BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD=$(cat "$state/bootstrap.secret")
case "$BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD" in *[!0-9a-f]*) exit 1;; esac
[ "${#BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD}" -eq 64 ] || exit 1
case "${OIDC_ISSUER_PORT:?}" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac
[ "$OIDC_ISSUER_PORT" -ge 1024 ] && [ "$OIDC_ISSUER_PORT" -le 65535 ] || exit 1
base_url=${JELLYFIN_BASE_URL:?}
[ "$base_url" = /synopkgland/SynoPkgJellyfin ] || exit 1
# A retained volume must refresh branding and provider settings after migration.
oidc_fingerprint=$(printf '%s:%s:%s' "$OIDC_SECRET" "$OIDC_ISSUER_PORT" "$base_url" | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
budget=${SYNOPKGLAND_STARTUP_BUDGET_SECONDS:?}
case "$budget" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 1;; esac
deadline=$(($(date +%s)+budget))
network() {
    printf '<?xml version="1.0"?><NetworkConfiguration><BaseUrl>%s</BaseUrl><InternalHttpPort>%s</InternalHttpPort><EnableHttps>false</EnableHttps><EnableIPv4>true</EnableIPv4><EnableIPv6>false</EnableIPv6><AutoDiscovery>false</AutoDiscovery><EnableUPnP>false</EnableUPnP><LocalNetworkAddresses><string>%s</string></LocalNetworkAddresses><KnownProxies><string>127.0.0.1</string></KnownProxies></NetworkConfiguration>\n' "$base_url" "$1" "$JELLYFIN_BIND" > "$state/config/config/network.xml"
}
cleanup_secrets() { rm -f "$state/auth.json" "$state/curl-auth.conf" "$state/provider-live.json" "$state/library-list.json"; }
trap cleanup_secrets EXIT
server=''
stop() { cleanup_secrets; if [ -n "$server" ]; then kill "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }
trap 'stop; exit 1' INT TERM HUP
if [ ! -f "$state/bootstrap.complete" ] || [ "$(cat "$state/oidc.fingerprint" 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$oidc_fingerprint" ]; then
    network 29497
    /jellyfin/jellyfin &
    server=$!
    until [ "$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 "http://127.0.0.1:29497$base_url/health" 2>/dev/null || true)" = Healthy ]; do
        kill -0 "$server" 2>/dev/null || { echo 'Bootstrap server failed' >&2; exit 1; }
        [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ] || { stop; echo 'Bootstrap deadline exceeded' >&2; exit 1; }
        sleep 1
    done
    api=http://127.0.0.1:29497$base_url
    info=$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 "$api/System/Info/Public")
    if ! printf '%s' "$info" | grep -iq '"StartupWizardCompleted"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true'; then
        curl -fsS --max-time 30 "$api/Startup/User" >/dev/null
        printf '{"Name":"package-bootstrap","Password":"%s"}' "$BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD" > "$state/auth.json"
        curl -fsS --max-time 30 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST --data-binary @"$state/auth.json" "$api/Startup/User" >/dev/null
        curl -fsS --max-time 30 -X POST "$api/Startup/Complete" >/dev/null
    fi
    printf '{"Username":"package-bootstrap","Pw":"%s"}' "$BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD" > "$state/auth.json"
    response=$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: MediaBrowser Client="Package Setup", Device="Package", DeviceId="package-bootstrap", Version="1"' --data-binary @"$state/auth.json" "$api/Users/AuthenticateByName")
    token=$(printf '%s' "$response" | sed -n 's/.*"AccessToken"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([0-9a-fA-F]*\)".*/\1/p')
    [ -n "$token" ] || { stop; echo 'Bootstrap authentication failed' >&2; exit 1; }
    printf 'header = "Authorization: MediaBrowser Token=%s"\n' "$token" > "$state/curl-auth.conf"
    sed "s/__CLIENT_SECRET__/$OIDC_SECRET/g; s/__OIDC_ISSUER_PORT__/$OIDC_ISSUER_PORT/g" "$state/provider.json" > "$state/provider-live.json"
    curl -fsS --max-time 30 -K "$state/curl-auth.conf" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$state/provider-live.json" "$api/sso/OID/Add/dsm" >/dev/null
    # The supported branding API provides a one-click fallback after native hash-route logout.
    curl -fsS --max-time 30 -K "$state/curl-auth.conf" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$state/branding.json" "$api/System/Configuration/Branding" >/dev/null
    curl -fsS --max-time 30 -K "$state/curl-auth.conf" "$api/Library/VirtualFolders" > "$state/library-list.json"
    if ! grep -q '"Name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"Media"' "$state/library-list.json"; then
        curl -fsS --max-time 30 -K "$state/curl-auth.conf" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$state/library.json" "$api/Library/VirtualFolders?name=Media&collectionType=movies&refreshLibrary=false" >/dev/null
    fi
    printf '%s' "$oidc_fingerprint" > "$state/oidc.fingerprint"
    kill "$server"; wait "$server" || true; server=''
fi
# Only the final, configured server uses the SDK health/listen port.
network 29496
if [ -f "$state/bootstrap.complete" ]; then
    cleanup_secrets
    trap - INT TERM HUP
    exec /jellyfin/jellyfin
fi
/jellyfin/jellyfin &
server=$!
until [ "$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 "http://127.0.0.1:29496$base_url/health" 2>/dev/null || true)" = Healthy ]; do
    kill -0 "$server" 2>/dev/null || { cleanup_secrets; exit 1; }
    [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ] || { stop; exit 1; }
    sleep 1
done
# A refresh is asynchronous: request it from the final process, which remains alive.
curl -fsS --max-time 30 -K "$state/curl-auth.conf" -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:29496$base_url/Library/Refresh" >/dev/null
cleanup_secrets
: > "$state/bootstrap.complete"
wait "$server"
